values: 贮存1名友军的灵魂，使其在遭受最后一击后，能以“灵魂形态”继续战斗。
Niru stores 1 ally's soul, allowing them to continue fighting on the battlefield in Spirit form after taking a fatal blow.
尼汝对1名友军释放咒语。这名友军受到最后一击后，不会被击败，生命值恢复至最大生命值的45%，并进入“灵魂形态”。“灵魂形态”下的角色可以继续照常战斗，但只能造成45% + 5%的伤害，每秒失去生命值，并且失去生命值的速度逐渐提升，直至耗尽后将被彻底击败。本技能优先选择最虚弱的友军作为目标。

Niru prioritizes the weakest ally and casts a spell to protect them from a fatal blow, turning them into a Spirit and restoring their HP to 45% of max HP. The Spirit can only deal 45% + 5% of its original damage while losing an increasing amount of HP every second. Once its HP runs out, the Spirit will be defeated.
每累计有1名（至多为5）除召唤物以外敌人被击败，被本技能施加咒语的角色在进入“灵魂形态”时额外恢复10%最大生命值。
For every (up to 5) non-summoned enemy defeated, the blessed ally restores an extra 10% of max HP when entering the Spirit form.
每当有除召唤物以外敌人被击败时，处于“灵魂形态”的角色立即恢复10%最大生命值（每名角色至多因此恢复5次）。
For every non-summoned enemy defeated, the ally in Spirit form restores 10% of max HP (up to 5 times for each character).
“灵魂形态”下的英雄造成的伤害提升至55% + 5%。
Ally in Spirit form deals 55% + 5% of the original damage.
“灵魂形态”下的英雄造成的伤害提升至65% + 5%。
Ally in Spirit form deals 65% + 5% of the original damage.
对最虚弱的1名敌人造成伤害，目标生命值越低则伤害越高。
Niru deals damage to the weakest enemy. The lower the target's HP, the higher the damage.
尼汝对最虚弱的1名敌人造成120% + 20% ATK伤害，并额外造成其当前损失的生命值的0.3倍的伤害（额外伤害不超过450% ATK）。
Niru attacks the weakest enemy, dealing 120% + 20% ATK damage plus damage equal to 0.3 times the target's lost HP. The additional damage cannot exceed 450% ATK.
额外造成其当前损失的生命值的0.35倍的伤害（额外伤害不超过525% ATK）。
Increases additional damage to 0.35 times of the target's lost HP, up to 525% ATK.
额外造成其当前损失的生命值的0.4倍的伤害（额外伤害不超过600% ATK）。
Increases additional damage to 0.4 times of the target's lost HP, up to 600% ATK.
额外造成其当前损失的生命值的0.45倍的伤害（额外伤害不超过600% ATK）。
Increases additional damage to 0.45 times of the target's lost HP, up to 600% ATK.
抽取所有敌人的生命力，治疗最虚弱的友军。
Niru drains the life force of all enemies to heal the weakest ally.
尼汝抽取所有敌人的生命力，对每名敌人造成150% + 15% ATK伤害，额外附带目标最大生命值3%的伤害（不超过70% ATK），并使最虚弱的友军恢复等同于伤害数额的生命值。
Niru drains the life force of all enemies, dealing 150% + 15% ATK damage to each enemy, plus 3% of the target's max HP, up to 70% ATK. He then restores an equal amount of HP to the weakest ally.
对每名敌人造成的伤害提升至160% + 15% ATK，额外附带最大生命值3.5%的伤害（不超过80% ATK）。
The damage dealt to each enemy is increased to 160% + 15% ATK, plus 3.5% of the target's max HP, up to 80% ATK.
对每名敌人造成的伤害提升至170% + 15% ATK，额外附带最大生命值4%的伤害（不超过90% ATK）。
The damage dealt to each enemy is increased to 170% + 15% ATK, plus 4% of the target's max HP, up to 90% ATK.
对每名敌人造成的伤害提升至180% + 15% ATK，额外附带最大生命值5%的伤害（不超过100% ATK）。
The damage dealt to each enemy is increased to 180% + 15% ATK, plus 5% of the target's max HP, up to 100% ATK.
战斗中，自身的生命值提升17%。
战斗中，自身的生命值提升23%。
战斗中，自身的生命值提升29%。
在战斗开始时不消耗能量释放终极技能。
Niru casts Ultimate without consuming Energy when a battle starts.
战斗开始时，尼汝不消耗能量对最近的友军释放终极技能，优先以自己身后的友军作为目标。
Niru casts Ultimate on the nearest ally without consuming Energy when a battle starts, prioritizing the ally behind himself.
进入“灵魂形态”的英雄不会随着时间失去生命值，直至我方所有友军累计处于“灵魂形态”形态8秒。
The Spirits will not lose HP over time until all allies enter Spirit form for 8s.
直至我方所有友军累计处于“灵魂形态”形态10秒。
Until all allies enter Spirit form for 10s.
直至我方所有友军累计处于“灵魂形态”形态12秒。
Until all allies enter Spirit form for 12s.
“灵魂收割”使敌人一段时间无法恢复生命。
Niru's Soul Reaping briefly prevents the enemy from recovering HP.
技能“灵魂收割”还能使敌人在8秒内无法恢复生命。
Niru's Soul Reaping prevents the enemy from recovering HP for 8s.
普通攻击替换为“吞灵汲命”，且造成的伤害下降至原来的75%。当“吞灵汲命”对雪米拉或戴蒙产生治疗时，还会使其提升60%的护甲和魔抗，持续8秒。

Replaces normal attacks with Spirit Devour, which deals only 75% of the skill's original damage. When Spirit Devour heals Shemira or Daimon, it also increases their Phys DEF and Magic DEF by 60% for 8s.
